entry.title: Icelandic Phallological Museum

buildingCutout.basis: The five-sided Kalkofnsvegur 2 host block as mapped. Adjacent buildings, streets and pedestrian frontage stay native.

terrainReference.basis: The mapped museum marker sets the zero floor on the terrain supplied by the World Viewer host.

entry.note: The museum occupies the glass corner of a shared retail and office building. The model covers the exterior of its occupied block, including the surrounding storefronts and stepped office terraces. The exterior and doorway are aligned to PMTiles and photographs. Window fittings, signs and roof services are approximations. The exhibit interior is outside the model scope. The building follows the host terrain at the museum point. The standard Terrarium sample at this waterfront has a substantial vertical offset from the visible coastline, so it serves as a local grade reference. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
